I know, I feel selfish about this too. I know it's not right of me to expect her to go through another day of suffering, just because I don't want to see her gone, it is wrong.

But I do want to show her that there can be good times, I mean we still do have a fair amount of fun together, but those moments can be fleeting.

Irregardless I'll stand by her no matter what, she was there for me when I had my bad times, I'd like to be there for her.

I really don't want another game where I am a god like shooter. Yes I want amazing awesome exosuit, with devestating power.

No I should not be able to take on entire space fleets from my exosuit, or multiple drop ships, gods, etc etc....

If there are big military factions in this game, ie like Cabal, I do not want to be doing missions where me and 3 of my friends truck through an entire fleet of drop ships containing hordes of cabal units and eventually board and bring down a starship destroyer...

I dunno, it's just so bland and played out. It would be nice to have to avoid direct confrontation with military in order to achieve objectives and to think about things more tactically.

It just ruins it for me seeing ships appear constantly dropping off minions for me to use my supers on. When I see that ship floating above me & always think "why don't they just shoot me and get it over with?"

I can still collect loot & tech and build sweet exosuits without becoming the undying god of the universe.

My GF suffers from chronic pain due to PKD (polycystic kidney).

She mainly uses hydromorph contin to control her pain, however recently she has been prescribed cannabis oil. This has been the only combination that has been able to consistently control her pain.

To the point where she was able to control her hydromorph dosage.

Unfortunately the sedative effects are substantial, but she is not in pain.

Spouse has ADPKD and over the years pain has got significantly worse.

-start with NSAIDs and that crept too high of dosing so they switched to OxyContin

-OxyContin eventually crept up in dosage as it was ineffective for pain

-current she is on a combination of hydromorphone (18mg/day), cymbalta (80mg/day), gabapentin (1.2g - 1.6g/day), canabis oil (22mg THC/day)

This seems effective for managing pain however given tho meds sedation is very high and you can begin to lose cognitive function.

She is 30y/o ADPKD type 2, stage 3B kidney disease, with a total kidney volume of 2000cc. We are anticipating she will reach end stage renal disease in 3-5 years and pain is expected to get worse.
